run: 2026-11-12, local: yosys 0.33, z3 4.8.12, SymbiYosys (formal-deb env); order_ctl rerun on the final RTL (soft reset free, 2-bit frame counter); interlocks rerun with req_noref

assumptions.interlocks: configuration stable after reset; bucket <= 4; refill 3..6 clocks; reload not used; every other input free (including the no-band-reference request flag)
assumptions.mac_tx: MIN_DATA 4, IFG 3, frame length 1..6 bytes, a byte every clock (1000 Mb/s)
assumptions.mac_rx: MIN_FRAME 5, MAX_FRAME 8; the CRC abstracted as a free value (checked against zlib in simulation)
assumptions.order_ctl: every input free, soft resets included; an abstract MAC (3-clock frames); watchdog 8 clocks; frame counter 2 bits (GEN_W = 2, so its wrap is reachable); one ghost order chosen by the solver. Bounded check (depth 30), not a proof: a bad-frame order is never started once known; one that left with a good FCS is followed by a cancel within 12 clocks, across soft resets; a cancel only follows a bad frame or the watchdog; safe mode never sends before a good verdict; one request per frame, and a trigger in a frame that has not asked always makes one when the slot is free; the slot is never busy for more than 24 clocks.

not_proved: k-induction of the MAC FSMs (needs invariants on internal state); returned UNKNOWN, so those tasks were removed
order_ctl_limits: outside the 30-clock bound: backlogs of several orders (an earlier order's cancel pending plus an ARP reply plus a new order needs about 33 clocks) and the 16-bit age counter's saturation; the RTL's 8-bit frame counter is checked only through the 2-bit one
